summary.text: Herman Hall is the Republican nominee for NY State Assembly District 42, running against incumbent Rodneyse Bichotte Hermelyn. The Republican primary was canceled, and he advanced without appearing on the ballot. Ballotpedia lists him as the Conservative Party candidate for the New York State Senate in 2014.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, Hall ran for New York State Senate in 2014 as the Conservative Party candidate, losing the general election to incumbent Kevin Parker.
